blocks.text: Wedding bells are ringing for singer-actress Danita Paner after she officially announced her engagement to longtime non-showbiz boyfriend Ralph Ian Fernandez. Paner shared the milestone on Instagram, posting snapshots from a scenic beachside proposal at sunset. In the photos, the couple embraced on the sand beside glowing marquee letters spelling out “MARRY ME,” surrounded by flickering candles and scattered rose petals. READ: Danita’s real dream is to be a rock star “Here’s to forever with my favorite person,” Paner wrote in her caption, adding a ring and heart emoji.
